title: Software Release Research Minimum Contract
$comment: This is the blocking minimum contract, not a completeness or editorial-quality schema. The richer optional shape is instructed by task.md and may be linted only as nonblocking findings. ResearchOps preserves every record and raw optional property; it does not reject a candidate because coverage, source detail, service detail, or an optional artifact is incomplete.

releaseRecordMinimum.$comment: These are the only blocking business fields because they provide stable identity and the branch value required by this task's recipient-group rule. All other source properties are carried forward losslessly and optional-shape problems are warnings.
